name: Samuel
overview: The story of Samuel begins with the heartfelt prayer of his mother, Hannah, who, in deep anguish, vows to dedicate her son to the Lord if He grants her a child. As recorded in 1 Samuel 1:10-11, her earnest petition and vow demonstrate a profound trust in God's providence and faithfulness. The narrative highlights Samuel's consecration to God from birth, setting the stage for his role as a prophet and judge in Israel. This introduction reveals the significance of faithful prayer and dedication to God's service, foundational themes in Samuel's life and ministry.
